title: feat(metadata): the layered read takes the bundle member selector
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB8p7MBsAnbgGywykCisiqcv)_

Fixes #26699

#26649 stays open: it keeps the ui half (the Setup row link, the Locale column, and the editor passing the member to its layered and draft reads), and stays `pm:blocked` on this PR.

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no skill or hand-written doc teaches `/layers` or its query parameters (`git grep -n "/layers\|getMetaItemLayered\|META_ITEM_LAYERS" -- skills/ .claude/skills/` → 0 hits; the only hand-written docs naming `/layers` are `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx:192` and `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx:366`, which describe its read gate, not its parameters)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** Setup 编辑页读的分层视图(`GET /meta/:type/:name/layers`)现在能按语言读邮件模板的某一种语言(`?member=zh-CN`):代码层、覆盖层、生效值都是那种语言的;不带参数仍是默认语言,行为不变。
- **为什么改:** 多语言邮件模板的第二种语言在 Setup 里打不开(#26649),按 #26649 的裁决 A,服务端这扇门先补上,ui 半边随后。
- **风险与回滚:** 只给一个闭集加一个参数(`package` → `package`、`member`),两条传输路径共用同一个判定;不存在的语言答 404,不会退回默认语言;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 的 `getMetaItemLayered`(代码层按成员收窄的那段);`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts` 的 `/layers` 入口(改问共享判定);`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts` 的 `META_ITEM_LAYERS_PARAMS`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts`,预期 35 个测试全绿,其中 5 个是本 PR 的分层读取用例。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地(席位先做一次契约复审)。

## What changes

- **Spec** (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`): `GetMetaItemLayeredRequestSchema` gains `member`, described by the same `BUNDLE_MEMBER_SELECTOR_DESCRIPTION` the get, delete, publish and history requests use. Generated: `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` (one row) and `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` (one key).
- **Protocol** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, `getMetaItemLayered`): takes `member`, read through `resolveBundleMemberSelector` exactly as `getMetaItem` reads it. Every layer is that member's: the MetadataService copy counts only when it is the addressed member; the artifact lookup asks for the member (`lookupArtifactItem(…, wantedMember)`); the registry is asked for a named member and an answer for another member is dropped; the package-less address and the served-row resolution get the member. A member no layer holds answers no layer, which both doors answer `404`.
- **REST** (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, `meta-item-read-routes.ts`, `rest-server.ts`): `META_ITEM_LAYERS_PARAMS` is `['package', 'member']`, and the `layers` door's arity list carries `member`. RestServer's `/layers` route now asks `metaItemQueryRefusal('layers', …)` (ruling 6138588561, letter B), as its item read and the runtime dispatcher's `/layers` already do, writing the nested `{ error: { code, message } }` its `refuseUnknownQueryParams` call wrote. `serveMetaItemLayered` spreads `metaMemberSelector(req.query)` into the request.
- **Runtime** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`): the dispatcher's `/layers` hands `metaMemberSelector(query)` to `answerMetaLayered`, which spreads it into `getMetaItemLayered`.
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/26699-layered-read-member.md`, `minor` on spec, metadata-protocol, rest and runtime, with both declaration lines.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/environment-overlay-email-locale-restart.test.ts` (real engine, real protocol), new `[#26699]` block: the layered read of `zh-CN` answers `code: 'PKG zh'`, `overlay: 'ADMIN zh'`; a member nobody stored answers its own code layer and no overlay; CONTROL the canonical read (absent and `en-US`) answers the canonical layers, and the whole answer for `member: 'en-US'` equals the bare one; `fr-FR` answers no layer; a member on `view` and a blank one are the located `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (status and code asserted). A protocol over the same engine with a MetadataService double whose copy is `zh-CN`: the canonical read (absent and `en-US`) reports `code: 'PKG en'`, never the service's other member, and the `zh-CN` read reports the service copy (`SVC zh`).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-item-query-decision.test.ts`, the `/layers` block on both transports: an unrecognised name is the same located 400 on both (`Supported parameters: member, package.`); a repeated `member` is the same refusal on both and the protocol is never called; `?member=zh-CN` reaches `getMetaItemLayered` with the package beside it on both, and no selector sends no `member` key; `fr-FR` is `404` on both; a member on `view` reaches the real protocol and comes out as `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with its sentence on both.
- Pins updated: `packages/rest/src/meta-item-query-decision.test.ts` (closed-set pin, the layers door now passes `member`, a repeated `member` refused), `packages/rest/src/rest-server-meta-door-closed-sets.test.ts` (`/layers` left the member-refusing list; its unknown-name refusal stays pinned), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.lookup-artifact-item-call-sites.test.ts` (the layered code-layer lookup's recorded arguments now carry `wantedMember`).

## Acceptance notes

- **The canonical read, one narrow change.** With no member named, the code layer's MetadataService copy now counts only when it is the canonical member, as `getMetaItem`'s does (#22877). For every type without members nothing moves. For an `email_template` whose service copy is a non-canonical member (the service keys by name, so it holds whichever member registered last), the canonical layered read used to report that member as `code`; it now falls to the canonical artifact, the body the by-name read serves. The MetadataService-double test in the objectql file pins this (ablated below).
- **The deprecated `?layers=` spelling is unchanged.** It still refuses a `member` beside it, with the sentence pinned byte for byte ("Read one member with `?member=` alone."). That remedy could now also name `/layers?member=`; left as is to keep the pinned answer, and the spelling is on its way out.
- **SDK.** `MetadataClient.layered()` lives in `ui/packages/data-objectstack` and takes `{ packageId }` only. The editor needs `member` there, and that is #26649's ui half per its ruling, so it is not touched here.
- **Declarations.** Both lines are copied from the claim (6448343327). Two readings for the seat: the claim writes `Clause-②: yes` without an arm, while the change is a widening (`yes (widening)` would also be accurate); and the director's ruling record on #26649 (6444406836) spelled this card `Metadata-protocol: none`, since a REST query parameter is not something a metadata author writes, while the claim says `added`.

## Verification

Restored (`git diff HEAD` empty, blob equal to HEAD), rebuilt, preflight `--absent` exit 0, then 34/34 passed. Taken at `c71460ec1`.
